# secret-scan

> Rust secret scanner CLI — 50 patterns, entropy analysis, Base64/hex obfuscation detection. cargo install secretscan

secret-scan is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/secret-scan/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/adventurewave-labs/secret-scan): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install secretscan
```
